label: "to" token detector (all forms)
explanation: Fires on virtually every occurrence of the token "to" in any form — lowercase, capitalized, sentence-initial, all-caps, and even French "à" — regardless of position or grammatical role (infinitive marker or preposition). It fires strongest on the canonical mid-sentence lowercase " to" and more weakly on sentence-initial "To" and hyphenated compounds like "ready-to-use"; it is silent on all other tokens except negligible spillover (e.g., "Encode").
